_metadata.description: Single source of truth for IncuBrix product facts, pricing tiers, verified live features, and roadmap flags to ensure zero unverified claims.

brand.name: IncuBrix
brand.tagline: Create With Purpose. Publish Without Limits.

starter.name: Starter Plan
features: Animated kinetic subtitles with creator fonts

essential.name: Essential Plan
features: Silence and filler word remover (um/uh cutting)
Custom brand templates and logo watermarking
Batch export up to 10 clips simultaneously
Direct publishing to YouTube Shorts and TikTok

growth.name: Growth Plan
features: AI multi-language translation and subtitle dubbing in 40+ languages
Priority cloud rendering queue (<60s render times)

scale.name: Scale Plan
features: Advanced retention analytics and hook scoring
Shared brand kit and custom font uploads

pro.name: Pro Plan
features: Full REST API access for automated programmatic pipelines

enterprise.name: Enterprise Plan
features: Custom credit allocations and dedicated infrastructure
Dedicated account manager and technical lead

ai_highlight_detection.description: Identifies the highest-retention moments and viral hooks from long-form audio/video using engagement scoring algorithms.

kinetic_captions.description: Word-by-word animated subtitles with custom creator typography, color highlighting, and 99.2% transcription accuracy across 40+ languages.

active_speaker_centering.description: Computer vision face tracking automatically detects active speakers in 16:9 landscape footage and centers them seamlessly into 9:16 vertical video.

text_based_editing.description: Edit video by modifying the interactive transcript; deleting a word or paragraph automatically snips the corresponding video frames.

filler_word_silence_removal.description: 1-click automated removal of filler pauses ('um', 'uh', 'you know') and dead air to tighten pacing.

multi_platform_publishing.description: Simultaneous syndication and scheduled publishing to YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, and LinkedIn from a unified dashboard.

cloud_render_speed.description: Cloud-accelerated GPU rendering delivering 60-second vertical clips in under 90 seconds.

custom_ai_avatars.note: Digital twin avatars are currently in closed engineering development; NOT live.

voice_cloning_realtime_dubbing.note: Voice cloning dubbing is in invite-only beta testing; NOT available on public self-serve plans.

full_script_to_video_generation.note: Autonomous text-prompt to multi-scene generation is currently in R&D; IncuBrix currently specializes in video repurposing from existing footage.

creator_personas.primary_pain: Spending 8-10 hours every week manually editing video podcasts into TikTok and Shorts clips.
Repurposing 60-minute webinars and client customer stories into executive LinkedIn clips.
Adding multilingual subtitles and punchy teasers to instructional video libraries.
Managing batch video rendering and client brand templates for 10+ creator clients simultaneously.
Extracting high-octane clutch moments from 4-hour Twitch streams for daily YouTube Shorts.
